author: smorgasburg
title: Looking for illustrator for 2027 NYC vendor flyer
content: Smorgasburg, through your eyes. 🎨 Calling all local artists! We’re looking for a local illustrator or designer to create our 2027 NYC vendor application flyer! This is a paid commission, with full artist credit and the potential for many future collaborations. We want to see something different from our past flyers. Something unmistakably New York that captures the messy, human experience of eating here: hands making food, friends sharing a bite, cultures meeting across a counter. Your style, your perspective. Submit your portfolio or Instagram through the link in bio by November 10. A sketch is optional, but including one helps us understand your vision and may speed up our review—rough ideas are welcome. The final flyer, featuring the selected artist’s work, will be posted on November 20. Know someone we should see? Tag them below.

author: mostafa_gawad
title: Hiring Vector Background Artists for animated series
content: 🎨 WE’RE HIRING! – VECTOR BACKGROUND ARTISTS JUMP ANIMATION is looking for talented Vector Background Artists to join our upcoming animated series project! Requirements: * Strong skills in creating 2D vector backgrounds. * Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator or Adobe Animate. * Ability to match an established cartoon art style. * Attention to detail and good artistic skills. Project Duration: 2–3 Months (Freelance). 📩 Send your CV and Portfolio to: * jobs@jumpanimation.com * gawad26@gmail.com 💬 You can also message us directly through Facebook! If you’re passionate about cartoon backgrounds and 2D animation, we’d love to hear from you!

author: ctfdn_official
title: Horror illustrators wanted for paid opportunities
content: HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027. If you have a talent for bringing nightmares to life—from unsettling atmosphere to terrifying creatures—we’d love to see your work. Experience with illustrated lettering or incorporating text into your artwork is a plus, but not required. These are paid gigs. We’re seeking human-created artwork only for this particular endeavor. We won’t accept AI-generated or AI-assisted artwork. Interested? Email Craig Groshek with your portfolio, rates, and availability: Email: craiggroshek [at] chillingtalesfordarknights.com Subject line: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST
